title_original: Lessons from 59 Linux Kernel Bug Reports
description: Microsoft FORGE Lab researchers used codename MDASH to investigate Linux kernel vulnerabilities, resulting in 59 upstream bug reports, 33 assigned CVEs, and 38 merged fixes. The research includes eight demonstrated local root privilege-escalation exploits and examines the challenges of turning AI-generated findings into validated vulnerabilities and upstream fixes.The postLessons from 59 Linux Kernel Bug Reportsappeared first onMicrosoft Security Blog.
